svg.text: Viewed from BELOW • letters run X → A • flip left-to-right, never copy the top view unchanged
Four corner fixing zones: actual holes must be measured
Insulated point-to-point links on the copper side; crossings remain insulated. No continuous solder rails implied.
Lead pads are shared by their component and its solder joint, not by two component leads pushed into one hole.
Keep C1 leads short. Keep copper-side wires/solder below 3 mm so the 10 mm panel standoff space stays clear.
No strip or lamp load current through the pad network. LED supply/capacitor spur is wired separately at C2/C3.
